title: Do not decorate the life that forgot the Beloved
summary: A life deceived by duality cannot be beautified from the outside. Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: A life deceived by duality cannot be beautified from the outside.
source.lifeApplication: When you reach for another surface fix, ask what the Shabad still needs to heal.

evidence.coreClaim: A life deceived by duality cannot be beautified from the outside.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: without the Beloved and the Shabad, surface beauty stays false.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.
